head.t: STERIS agrees to buy Xodus Medical (Pink Pad patient positioning) for $2.1bn
head.x: STERIS agreed to acquire Xodus Medical for $2.1bn cash at closing (about $1.8bn net of tax benefits), plus an earnout of up to $150m tied to 2028 targets. Xodus expects about $245m revenue in 2026. Closing expected by 31 December 2026, subject to regulatory approvals.
